info.name: WebMind API - QA Assignment (Part 10) - CONFIRMED endpoints
info.description:
API test collection for WebMind (RAG-Powered Website Chatbot).

All request URLs and body field names in this version are CONFIRMED from live DevTools Network captures (not assumed) as of 31 Jul 2026:
- signup/login -> http://localhost:8000/auth/{signup,login} (see key finding below)
- ingest -> https://pradeep002-claysys-rag-project.hf.space/ingest
- chat -> https://pradeep002-claysys-rag-project.hf.space/chat

KEY FINDING #1: signup and login point at localhost:8000, which only resolves on the developer's own machine. For any other user these requests fail to connect. Log as a Critical defect.

KEY FINDING #2: the captured /ingest and /chat requests show no Authorization header or session cookie in DevTools. The 'No Authentication Header' requests in each folder verify whether these endpoints enforce auth at all - if they return 200 with no credentials attached, that's a second Critical defect (unauthenticated access to the AI backend).

Response field names (e.g. website_id capture) are best-guess since only request payloads were captured, not response bodies - check a real /ingest response in DevTools' Response tab and adjust the test script in 'Ingest Website - Success' if needed.
